title: Six small easter eggs
summary: A few hidden interactions for people who like keyboard shortcuts, debug flags and the number six.

sections.heading: 1. The Konami code
paragraphs: Press Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, B, A. A brief shower of sixes appears. No extra lives, unfortunately.

sections.heading: 2. Trace the header
paragraphs: Tap the BS badge six times within seven seconds. A temporary diagnostics-inspired outline appears. The labels are decorative, not live system measurements.

sections.heading: 3. Six sixes
paragraphs: Press the 6 key six times within five seconds to reveal the floating hex field. Holding the key down does not count.

sections.heading: 4. Verify the checksum
paragraphs: At the bottom of the page, click 0x06 six times within eight seconds. The footer acknowledges your persistence.

sections.heading: 5. Theme parity
paragraphs: Switch between light and dark six times within eight seconds to find the parity message. If rapid theme changes are uncomfortable, skip this one.

sections.heading: 6. A boot flag
paragraphs: Open any portfolio page with ?trace=6 at the end of its URL. For example: brunosalgado.dev/?trace=6. Trace mode activates for a few seconds.
